# Instructions for accurately documenting a failed industrial safety audit

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Record your date, your name and the name of the property owner in your safety log workbook.
3. Insert a sketch or photo of the room, yard, work area etc., you inspected.
4. Recognize any hazards that violate applicable OSHA codes.
5. Identify the OSHA code or explanation of the violation.
6. Identify the management aspects of safety, like employee awareness, training, or lack of equipment.
7. Write concern or hazard in Your Own Words in the comments section of your log book.
8. Write what must be accomplished to correct the hazard in the safety log book.

Before your company is audited by OSHA, you should conduct internal audits of your facility. When safety experts conduct professional audits for outside companies, the company must sign an auditor agreement. The agreement states the auditor will not identify the company in published reports as having failed an audit. You can use the same format to document
